account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the vetting record.

brand_sid.description: The unique string to identify Brand Registration.

brand_vetting_sid.description: The Twilio SID of the third-party vetting record.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was last updated specified in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was created specified in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

vetting_id.description: The unique identifier of the vetting from the third-party provider.

vetting_class.description: The type of vetting that has been conducted. One of “STANDARD” (Aegis) or “POLITICAL” (Campaign Verify).

vetting_status.description: The status of the import vetting attempt. One of “PENDING,” “SUCCESS,” or “FAILED”.

vetting_provider.description: The third-party provider that has conducted the vetting. One of “CampaignVerify” (Campaign Verify tokens) or “AEGIS” (Secondary Vetting).

url.description: The absolute URL of the Brand Vetting resource.
